title: The Hinge and the Answer
description: An instrumental conversation whose last question receives a sustained fifth.

title: A Pulse Leaves the Room
description: Unequal clocks migrate through changing acoustic/electric ensembles.
ending: pulse withdraws, two isolated colors remain

title: Chaconne of Unequal Steps
description: Repeating bass, imitative upper parts, chorale and concertino episodes in the original fields.
ending: ground bass completes beneath an unresolved upper strand

title: The Last Player Standing
description: A changing contrapuntal ensemble gradually exposes its individual players.
ending: successive exits at constant dynamic, last plucked note

title: Mouths of Light
description: Wordless formant voices alternate with reeds, electric keys and analog colors.
ending: sung vowel closes into a soft humming consonant

title: Echoes Have Their Own Meter
description: Dry ensemble phrases enter finite multi-tap delay and filtered repeat networks.
ending: source stops, echoes finish the phrase

title: The Trill Orchard
description: Trills become melody, counterpoint, accompaniment and changing harmonic color.
ending: trill decelerates and settles on its lower neighbor

title: A Sentence Interrupted
description: A second synthetic-vocal work: canonic syllables, solos and instrumental replies.
ending: a new vocal sentence is cut mid-syllable

title: An Ordinary Sky
description: A deliberately tonal 12-ET diversion: piano, winds, strings and electric colors.

title: Continuous Ground
description: Glissandi connect original field endpoints; sliding voices coexist with fixed anchors.
ending: several slides meet on one fixed pitch

title: Someone Forgot to Answer
description: Transparent calls, hockets and soft sustained clashes; melody remains exposed.
ending: a call followed by an intentional unanswered silence

title: The Reversible Room
description: The second effects work: reversed grains, fixed-pitch spectral color and restrained echoes.
ending: a reversed resonance breath, then a clean boundary

title: The First Thing, Elsewhere
description: Recurrent cells are moved through consonant subsets and unfamiliar instrumental families.
ending: the opening returns in reversed orchestration

title: Distance Between Footsteps
description: A large layered process: moving registers, multiple clocks, clearings and renewed motion.
ending: onsets spread farther apart without getting softer

title: Concertino With a Missing Soloist
description: Soloist and accompaniment trade roles in a dry, non-octave chamber concertino.
ending: soloist leaves; ensemble gives the final answer

title: Weather Beyond the Frame
description: A final large invention changes its own materials, densities and temporal scale.
ending: the final phrase folds backward into its own first event
